title: Monotone decision tree learning degree
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a rational learning parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, the monotone decision tree learning degree is the total-influence learning degree evaluated at $\sqrt{k}$ and $\varepsilon$.
